name: calculate_stock_cover
description: Days of cover and replenishment: for a finished good at a warehouse it returns cover per warehouse and transfer options; for a material (with quantity and need date) it ranks approved suppliers. Returns a calculation_id.
schema: [{"id":0,"property":"item_id","description":"SKU or material code","type":"string","required":true},{"id":1,"property":"location","description":"WH-A, WH-B, WH-C or FAC-1","type":"string","required":false},{"id":2,"property":"quantity","description":"Material quantity to replenish","type":"number","required":false},{"id":3,"property":"need_date","description":"Need date YYYY-MM-DD","type":"string","required":false}]
